Sample.warning: This section describes a post-hoc analysis of a subset of the sample, not the overall randomized sample size.

dxgive.evidence_source: [/page/5/Text/7] Twenty-one adolescents in the sample had an initial CES-D score of 16 to 23. They were compared to the 20 adolescents with a CES-D score of 24 or higher to examine potential differential effects of the interventions as a function of initial depression severity.
dxgive.warning: Entry criteria based on CES-D symptom scores, not formal diagnosis. Diagnosis was assessed during follow-up, but not explicitly stated as a baseline entry requirement or exclusion for the entire sample.
